name: crawl_url
description: Extract and summarize content from a specific webpage as markdown. Use for 'summarize this URL', 'extract the text from this page', 'scrape this article', or 'read the content at this link'. For JavaScript-heavy or incomplete fetches, use stealth mode. For structured facts, prices, or entities, use extraction_type llm, cosine, or regex. Default wait is normal (all resources loaded); use fast for DOM-ready only and avoid full/network-idle on live data sites. For deep research, use extraction_type='cosine' with semantic_filter. This tool reads one page; it does not click, log in, or follow a browsing trail. For that, use browser_use or browser_use_cloud. For a picture of the page, use screenshot_url.

urls.description: Multiple URLs to crawl (alternative to single url)

stealth.description: Enable stealth mode to bypass bot detection. Use for protected sites like RT, IMDB, news sites.

wait_for.description: CSS selector to wait for before extracting content (e.g., '.main-content', '#article')

wait_for_js.description: DEPRECATED - use wait_strategy instead. Kept for backwards compatibility.

wait_strategy.description: How long to wait for page load: 'fast' (DOM only), 'normal' (all resources, DEFAULT), 'full' (network idle - AVOID for live data sites like financial/news)

page_timeout.description: Page load timeout in milliseconds (default 30000, max 60000)

delay_before_return_html.description: Seconds to wait after page load for JS to render (default 3.0, max 10.0)

js_code.description: Safe JS snippet name: 'dismiss_modal', 'scroll_down', 'accept_cookies' (arbitrary code blocked)

exclude_tags.description: HTML tags to exclude from output (default: nav, footer, aside, script, style)

extraction_type.description: Extraction strategy: 'llm' (LLM extraction), 'cosine' (semantic filtering), 'regex' (pattern matching), 'css' (CSS selector schema). Omit for raw markdown.

extraction_instruction.description: For extraction_type=llm: instruction for what to extract (e.g., 'Extract key price factors and predictions')

extraction_schema.description: For extraction_type=llm: Pydantic-style schema for structured output

semantic_filter.description: For extraction_type=cosine: topic/keyword to filter content by relevance (e.g., 'gold price forecast')

top_k.description: For extraction_type=cosine: number of top results to return (default 5)

regex_patterns.description: For extraction_type=regex: built-in patterns to use (email, phone, url, currency, date, percentage)

css_schema.description: For extraction_type=css: JsonCssExtractionStrategy schema {baseSelector: 'article', fields: [{name, selector, type}]}

availability.setup_hint: Set CRAWL4AI_URL in the active mode env file. CRAWL4AI_USER, CRAWL4AI_PASS, and CRAWL4AI_API_KEY are optional.
